Definition: combined, i.e. the nave or hub of a wheel (as holding the spokes together)
BiblicalUsage: Chishshur is the nave, the hub of a wheel that holds the spokes together, and it stands once beside its fellow in the same verse. The wheels of the temple bases have their naves as well as their spokes, each part cast as one with the whole, so the wheel turns true.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hub is the quiet centre that holds the work together, and the temple needed its hidden parts as much as its gold.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
